systems.tiers: Data from all 16,000 pre-primary, primary and secondary schools is collected on paper forms and entered into StatEduc at the education inspectorates, then passed up through the regional level to the centre

systems.owner: MEPSTA; developed by HISP West and Central Africa with GPE KIX and Norad support
systems.tiers: Implemented in 2021 in interoperability with StatEduc, processing its data into dashboards and School Report Cards for schools and sub-national actors; under review by the ministry as of December 2022

note: No fact: StatEduc is the paper-collected statistical return keyed at the inspectorates and DHIS2 processes it. The article says the system supports individual-level data to monitor learners but does not say schools enter any.
